{{- /* One-line description of a page for llms.txt and the Markdown versions. Uses the page description, or else the start of the page text without Markdown markers (shortcodes in summaries render as Markdown here). */ -}} {{- $d := .Description -}} {{- if not $d -}} {{- $d = .Summary | plainify | htmlUnescape -}} {{- $d = $d | replaceRE `\*\*|__` "" | replaceRE `(^|\s)>\s` " " | replaceRE `\s+` " " | strings.TrimSpace -}} {{- $d = $d | truncate 160 -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $d -}}
